descriptions.earrings-akoya-hanadama-8.0mm: looking for high-quality but a piece that can go with every occasion? the hanadama-certified akoya studs will be the one that suits you. mirror-bright luster in 18K gold/white gold, made to be worn every single day.
descriptions.akoya-earrings-hanadama85: if you're looking for that extra presence on your ears without going too bold, the 8.5mm hanadama studs hit that sweet spot. certified for exceptional luster and roundness — a piece you'll reach for every morning.
descriptions.akoya-earrings-diana: love the idea of a setting that makes your pearl look twice as luminous? the diana halo does exactly that, effortlessly elegant for both everyday wear and special occasions.
descriptions.earrings-akoya-diana-8.5mm: the ultimate upgrade — hanadama pearl meets diana setting. if you're treating yourself or someone special, this is the one. everything about it is just right.
descriptions.earrings-akoya-flower: not a fan of the plain round setting? the bloom earrings add character without being over the top. delicate gold petals that frame your pearl beautifully — a subtle statement piece.
descriptions.earrings-akoya-tie: a ribbon of gold holding a perfect pearl — it's the kind of detail that makes people ask "where did you get those?" dainty but distinctive, and pairs beautifully with everything.
descriptions.earrings-akoya-loveshaped: soft petal-shaped prongs that feel romantic without being over the top. for those who want their jewellery to say something about them — quietly and beautifully.
descriptions.earrings-akoya-bluerose: tired of white? the blue rose akoya is incredibly rare — a cool, rose-infused blue that photographs beautifully and looks unlike anything else. a collector's piece you can wear daily.
descriptions.earrings-akoya-bluerose-diana: the best of both worlds — the rarest akoya colour in the most loved setting. if you already love the diana earrings and want something truly unique, this is your next piece.
descriptions.earrings-akoya-diamnond-drop: want something with a bit more drama for evenings out? three diamonds cascade down from a lustrous akoya — it catches the light beautifully and moves with you. the pair that makes an entrance.
descriptions.earrings-akoya-bluerose-drop: the rare blue-rose akoya, now with movement. a single diamond holds the pearl as it sways softly — combine something rare with something graceful, and you get this.
descriptions.earclip-8.0mm: love pearl studs but don't have pierced ears? this is made exactly for you. the classic 8.0mm akoya — same luminous pearl, comfortable clip, zero compromise.
descriptions.earclip-bluerose: the coveted blue-rose akoya with no piercing required. rare colour, comfortable wear — beautiful jewellery should be for everyone.
descriptions.earclip-hanadama-8.5mm: hanadama quality in a clip setting — because exceptional luster shouldn't be limited to pierced ears. the finest certification at 8.5mm, now accessible to everyone.
descriptions.pendant-akoya-wg-diana: the diana halo in white gold with a hanadama pearl — for those who love the diana setting but want it in its finest possible form. a pendant you'll reach for when you want to feel your best.
descriptions.pendant-akoya-classic: sometimes less is more. one pearl, one chain — nothing gets in the way of the akoya's natural beauty. the piece that works with literally everything in your wardrobe.
descriptions.pendant-akoya-mermaid: for the ones who love a story behind their jewellery. a sculpted mermaid tail curves around a luminous akoya — whimsical but refined, and unlike anything you'll find elsewhere.
descriptions.necklace-akoya-star: want your necklace to be a little more expressive? the stellar sends light out in every direction from a central akoya pearl. for those who like to shine.
descriptions.necklace-akoya-5.5mm: the one you never take off. a full strand of 5.5mm akoya pearls, hand-knotted on silk — the kind of necklace that gets passed down. if you're buying one pearl necklace, make it this one.
descriptions.necklace-akoya-7.5mm: the same timeless piece, in a size that commands a room. at 7.5mm, each pearl is substantial enough to make a statement on its own. for those who want their pearl necklace noticed.
descriptions.necklace-t-akoya-3.5: if you love movement in your jewellery, the sunshine necklace delivers. tiny akoya pearls gather into a long, shimmering fringe — playful and luxurious at the same time.
descriptions.pendant-akoya-y: the y-drop is a modern classic — elongating, elegant, and impossible to get wrong. an akoya pearl rests at the tip, drawing the eye exactly where you want it.
descriptions.necklace-m-akoya-3.5: the delicate one that surprises everyone with its quality. hanadama-certified at just 3.5mm — layer it with anything or wear it solo as your everyday quiet luxury.
descriptions.necklace-m-akoya-8.5mm: love layered necklaces? this multi-strand at 8.0–8.5mm gives you that full, luxurious look without the hassle of styling multiple pieces. one wear, maximum impact.
descriptions.necklace-m-akoya-candy-8.0: want something with a bit of fun? the confetti necklace layers 7.5–8.0mm akoya pearls in a way that feels joyful and effortless. the pearl necklace for people who think pearl necklaces are too serious.
descriptions.ring-akoya-5mm: two akoya pearls on a slender band — modern, wearable, and just a little bit different from the usual single pearl ring. stack it with other rings or let it be the focal point.
descriptions.ring-akoya-ring-3.0mm: three small akoya pearls arc across the finger like the gentlest smile. it's the ring you can wear every day and feel just a little bit happier for it.
descriptions.bracelets-akoya-double: a bracelet that works as hard as you do. two strands of akoya pearls woven with gold stars — layer it or wear it as a statement on its own. the kind of piece your friends will keep asking about.
descriptions.bracelets-candy: bright, playful, and endlessly wearable — the confetti bracelet gathers akoya pearls in every natural tone. perfect for layering or as the piece that finishes any outfit.
descriptions.earrings-p-southsea-11.0mm: looking for that one pair that commands attention the moment you walk in? the venus-certified white south sea stud at 11.0mm is exactly that — extraordinary luster, impressive size, effortlessly elegant.
descriptions.earrings-southsea-pheonex-11mm: the phoenix represents transformation and rising — and these 11mm south sea earrings carry that energy. a meaningful piece for milestone moments or for someone who's come a long way.
descriptions.earrings-southsea-9.0mm-feather: love the size of south sea pearls but want something with more movement? the plume earrings let a 9.0mm pearl sway gently — substantial yet light, and incredibly graceful.
descriptions.earrings-southsea-drop: if you appreciate quality over ornamentation, this is your earring. a clean south sea pearl drop — nothing extra, nothing missing. the kind of piece that never dates.
descriptions.earrings-southsea-pheonix-12mm: the phoenix at 12mm is the statement piece. if you want all eyes on you and the confidence that comes with wearing something truly special, this is it.
descriptions.necklace-southsea-8.0-10.0: the south sea strand is the jewellery investment that pays forever. graduated from 8.0 to 10.0mm, it elevates any outfit — from a casual white tee to a gown. buy once, keep forever.
descriptions.pendant-southsea-apple: a playful piece that doesn't take itself too seriously — an 18K gold apple holding a south sea pearl. unexpected, charming, and a great conversation starter.
descriptions.pendant-southsea-flower: feminine but with real substance. a south sea pearl at the heart of a gold bloom — for those who love nature-inspired jewellery done with genuine quality.
descriptions.pendant-southsea-blue-y: if you want something that elongates and has real wow-factor, the silver blue y-drop does it effortlessly. the cool blue south sea pearl at the end of the chain is a showstopper.
descriptions.pendant-southsea-rainbow-y: south sea pearls with natural rainbow overtones are a rare find — and on a y-chain, the colour shifts with every move. the one piece that always looks different depending on the light.
descriptions.bracelets-southsea: the understated way to wear south sea. a single pearl on a fine k-gold bracelet — quiet confidence on the wrist. the one that real jewellery lovers will notice.
descriptions.earrings-tahitian: something about tahitian black pearls makes people do a double take. these 9.0mm classics have that signature dark luster — green, purple, silver — that you genuinely can't replicate with any other gem. the one for anyone curious about dark pearls.
descriptions.earclip-tahitian: the depth and drama of tahitian pearls at 9.0mm, designed for non-pierced ears. because exceptional jewellery should belong to everyone.
descriptions.earrings-tahitian-ocenblue: if you love tahitian pearls but want even more colour, the ocean blue is it. a grey tahitian with a vivid blue overtone that photographs like no other. genuinely one of the most striking things you'll ever wear.
descriptions.earrings-tahitian-ocenblue2: if you love tahitian pearls but want even more colour, the ocean blue is it. a grey tahitian with a vivid blue overtone that photographs like no other. genuinely one of the most striking things you'll ever wear.
descriptions.necklace-tahitian: no two strands are ever the same — that's the beauty of a multicolour tahitian necklace. black, grey, green, and peacock pearls selected for how they play off each other. a collector's piece that draws compliments every time.
descriptions.pendant-tahitian-necklace: one tahitian pearl on a delicate chain — dark, complex, and endlessly fascinating. for those who want something with depth and mystery rather than the expected.
descriptions.earrings-keshi-southsea-diana: the diana setting, now with south sea keshi pearls. all the structure of the classic diana halo with the organic beauty of keshi — for those who love a setting but want a pearl that's truly one of a kind.
descriptions.earrings-keshi-southsea-gold: warm, golden, and completely unique. south sea gold keshi pearls are a beautiful by-product of the harvest — which means each pair is slightly different, and you'll never find two exactly the same.
descriptions.earrings-keshi-tahitian-10mm: angular and bold — the prism earrings take a 10mm tahitian keshi pearl and give it a geometric edge. for those who love the idea of dark pearls but want a more contemporary take.
descriptions.earrings-keshi-southsea-drop: free-form south sea keshi pearls as drops — each one shaped by nature, each with a luster that rivals the finest round pearls. no two pairs will ever look exactly the same, and that's the whole point.
descriptions.earrings-keshi-tahitian-12mm: 12mm tahitian keshi drops are a bold choice — dark, iridescent, and completely individual. if you want jewellery that starts conversations, these are the ones.
descriptions.earrings-keshi-tahitian-three: three tahitian keshi pearls in a cascade — dark, iridescent, each subtly different. the kind of earring that feels effortless to put on and impossible to forget once you're wearing it.
descriptions.necklace-akoya-keshi: akoya keshi pearls have the luster of fine akoya with the freedom of organic form — each one is a natural anomaly. a strand of them together is something truly special.
descriptions.necklace-bluebarouque: baroque south sea pearls in cool blue-grey are an unusual find — the organic forms and cool tones together create something sculptural rather than just decorative. a necklace for those who want something genuinely different.
descriptions.necklace-freshwater-garden: freshwater pearls in a garden of natural shapes — petals, drops, and rounds all together. if you're someone who loves variety and organic beauty, the eden necklace is your pearl necklace.
